summary: No confirmed critical/high vulnerability or request-controlled server RCE was found. The two conditional medium availability defects and additive hardening items are remediated; the remaining deployment-trust observations are documented accepted architecture with existing controls.

findings.disposition: Bound generators and iterators incrementally before general JSON conversion; keep explicit streaming unchanged.
findings.implementation: pytincture/backend/results.py incrementally materializes bounded synchronous iterators before FastAPI conversion, closes them on a limit failure, rejects ordinary async iterables, and pytincture/backend/app.py performs ordinary serialization in the bounded BFF worker pool.
findings.compatibility_note: Finite ordinary generators remain JSON arrays within configured limits. Explicit streaming and yielded streaming responses are unchanged.

findings.disposition: Retain the compatibility default and existing isolated-process hard-kill option; add opt-in off-main-loop containment for trusted async stages.
findings.implementation: BFF_ASYNC_EXECUTION_MODE=worker-thread runs trusted non-streaming coroutine BFF functions and async policy hooks on bounded worker-thread event loops, retains admission after a timeout until abandoned work exits, and leaves the event-loop default and explicit streaming unchanged.
findings.existing_mitigation: BFF_EXECUTION_MODE=isolated-process runs non-streaming coroutine BFF operations in a killable, resource-limited child process.
findings.compatibility_note: Plain synchronous applications require no async knowledge. Default coroutine and explicit-streaming behavior remain available.

findings.disposition: Warn when the effective service account can write MODULES_PATH and provide optional fail-closed enforcement; filesystem immutability remains deployment-owned.
findings.implementation: Service startup emits one structured security.modules_path_writable warning when effective access and mount flags indicate a writable root. PYTINCTURE_REQUIRE_READONLY_MODULES_PATH=true fails configuration/startup closed, while the compatibility default remains false.
findings.compatibility_note: Enforcement is disabled by default, so writable development and quick-app directories continue to start.

findings.disposition: Document the executor as killable resource containment for deployment-trusted BFF code, not a hostile-code sandbox.
findings.compatibility_note: No mandatory sandbox, container, Redis service, or process mode is introduced.

findings.disposition: Treat selected browser/widget code as trusted application code; require SRI for external runtime resources and SHA-256 verification for widget assets.
findings.existing_mitigation: External Pyodide scripts and Material Icons fail closed without valid SRI; widget JavaScript and CSS must be manifest-owned and match SHA-256 locks.
findings.compatibility_note: Pluggable widgetsets and browser Python remain supported.

findings.disposition: Keep scripts same-origin and narrow default package connections to self plus exact PyPI origins, with explicit additional application origins.
findings.implementation: Service CSP connect-src defaults to self, https://pypi.org, and https://files.pythonhosted.org. PYTINCTURE_BROWSER_CONNECT_ORIGINS adds only canonical exact HTTPS/WSS origins after rejecting credentials, wildcards, paths, queries, fragments, duplicates, and injection syntax. script-src remains same-origin plus Pyodide-required directives.
findings.compatibility_note: Same-origin BFFs and micropip continue by default; direct browser connections to other APIs require exact configuration.

findings.disposition: Preserve class-level public-member export and the existing underscore-private exclusion.
findings.existing_mitigation: Static and runtime manifests exclude every member whose name begins with an underscore and require exact Pytincture decorator provenance.
findings.compatibility_note: No method-level decorator or redundant allowlist is required.
